_about: Per photo of the Drive folder (by its path there): 'alt', the words a screen reader and an image search read; 'skip' to leave it off, with 'why'. A key ending in / is a whole folder. '_cover' is the photo each folder's set opens on. scripts/unit_photos.py reads it.
